structure.unit: Other Regulated Providers of Financial Services

law.catch_line: Application for license; form; content; fee

text.section: An application for a license under this chapter shall be made in writing, under oath and on a form provided by the Commissioner.

The application shall be accompanied by payment of the following fees:
A license application fee of: a. In the case of an application for a license to act as a mortgage lender or a mortgage broker, $500; or b. In the case of an application for a license to act as both mortgage lender and mortgage broker, $1,000; and
An application fee of $150 for each office at which the business to be licensed is to be conducted.
The application fees shall not be refundable in any event. The fees shall not be abated by surrender, suspension or revocation of the license.
